after_hours_deferral.cutoff_basis: 17 CFR 232.13(a)(2); EDGAR Filer Manual Vol. II p. 3-34

does_not_support: independent corroboration by a second SEC field
A2_acceptance_header_only.label: A2
A2_acceptance_header_only.meaning: Raw header present; API value absent or inconsistent. The UTC instant is derived from the header alone.
supports: same as A, against the primitive field only

does_not_support: that the content was retrievable by an outsider at this instant
that the market had processed it
any claim about when the described event happened
A_acceptance_verified.label: A
A_acceptance_verified.meaning: Raw header ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (US/Eastern) is present and its DST-correct conversion equals data.sec.gov acceptanceDateTime.
supports: the filing was accepted by EDGAR no later than this UTC instant
intraday ordering of filings by this issuer
a lower bound for public availability

does_not_support: verification of the field's encoding or offset
B_acceptance_api_only.label: B
B_acceptance_api_only.meaning: Only the API acceptanceDateTime is available; no raw header read.
supports: a SEC-supplied acceptance instant, unverified against the archive

C_filing_date_only.label: C
C_filing_date_only.meaning: Only the calendar filingDate (US/Eastern day) is available.
supports: day-level membership: the filing is dated this Eastern day

D_unknown.label: D
D_unknown.meaning: No usable time field. Must be excluded from timed analysis.
